final: SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * t2.Bytes / t2.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t2 WHERE t2.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t2.MediaTypeId)) AS excess FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId HAVING AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * t2.Bytes / t2.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t2 WHERE t2.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t2.MediaTypeId))
